description: This file contains database migration scripts and setup functions for upgrading vtiger CRM from version 5.1.0 to 5.2.0 RC, including schema changes, data migrations, workflow setup, and webservice registration.

classes.name: VTWorkflowManager
classes.description: Class for managing workflows, creating new workflows, and saving them.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: Class for creating and saving workflow tasks.

methods.description: Populates security-related fields for a given tab and field ID.

methods.description: Registers a custom webservice operation for lead conversion.

methods.description: Migrates custom view configurations for different modules.

methods.description: Updates column names in advanced filter column list.
